<description>
I have split the changes into atomic commits so they can be changed/dropped easily.

Original motion: https://bugs.gentoo.org/987059
</description>

<commits>
5b198eca0c contrib/init/openrc: use /run/ instead of /var/run/

Freedesktop migrated to it:
https://specifications.freedesktop.org/fhs/latest/varRun.html#purpose46

Signed-off-by: Filip Kobierski <fkobi@pm.me>

978619f8b2 contrib/init/openrc: remove empty strings from eerror

it looks nicer

Signed-off-by: Filip Kobierski <fkobi@pm.me>

fcd8a5f409 contrib/init/openrc: use _OPTS variable inline

there's no need to redefine it with the rest

Signed-off-by: Filip Kobierski <fkobi@pm.me>

6053668e18 contrib/init/openrc: use SSD_NICELEVEL for setting niceness

Signed-off-by: Filip Kobierski <fkobi@pm.me>

1ecd14a376 contrib/init/openrc: do not `need net`

One should be able to restart the network service without restarting
bitcoind:
https://github.com/OpenRC/openrc/blob/master/service-script-guide.md#be-wary-of-need-net-dependencies

Signed-off-by: Filip Kobierski <fkobi@pm.me>

e7133f9b3f contrib/init/openrc: use command_user

it simplifies the script

Signed-off-by: Filip Kobierski <fkobi@pm.me>

5e7d477cd8 contrib/init/openrc: improve start_pre

now it is easier to comprehend

Signed-off-by: Filip Kobierski <fkobi@pm.me>

b876542a58 contrib/init/openrc: remove BITCOIND_BIN variable

only a single binary is shipped so this option does not make sense for end-users

Signed-off-by: Filip Kobierski <fkobi@pm.me>

cab8fb9300 contrib/init/openrc: remove BITCOIND_PIDFILE variable

and replace it with $RC_SVCNAME which guarantees it's uniqueness

Signed-off-by: Filip Kobierski <fkobi@pm.me>

e52c17dab1 contrib/init/openrc: remove BITCOIND_SIGTERM_TIMEOUT variable

and use `retry` directly

It is more powerful and more simple at the same time

Signed-off-by: Filip Kobierski <fkobi@pm.me>
</commits>

<files>

<patch>
diff --git a/contrib/init/bitcoind.openrcconf b/contrib/init/bitcoind.openrcconf
index c8a22a08d9..9a5bb69445 100644
--- a/contrib/init/bitcoind.openrcconf
+++ b/contrib/init/bitcoind.openrcconf
@@ -4,10 +4,7 @@
 #BITCOIND_CONFIGFILE="/etc/bitcoin/bitcoin.conf"
 
 # What directory to write pidfile to?  (created and owned by $BITCOIND_USER)
-#BITCOIND_PIDDIR="/var/run/bitcoind"
-
-# What filename to give the pidfile
-#BITCOIND_PIDFILE="${BITCOIND_PIDDIR}/bitcoind.pid"
+#BITCOIND_PIDDIR="/run/bitcoind"
 
 # Where to write bitcoind data (be mindful that the blockchain is large)
 #BITCOIND_DATADIR="/var/lib/bitcoind"
@@ -16,9 +13,6 @@
 #BITCOIND_USER="bitcoin"
 #BITCOIND_GROUP="bitcoin"
 
-# Path to bitcoind executable
-#BITCOIND_BIN="/usr/bin/bitcoind"
-
 # Nice value to run bitcoind under
 #BITCOIND_NICE=0
 
@@ -27,7 +21,5 @@
 
 # The timeout in seconds OpenRC will wait for bitcoind to terminate
 # after a SIGTERM has been raised.
-# Note that this will be mapped as argument to start-stop-daemon's
-# '--retry' option, which means you can specify a retry schedule
-# here. For more information see man 8 start-stop-daemon.
-BITCOIND_SIGTERM_TIMEOUT=600
+# For more information see man 8 start-stop-daemon.
+#retry=600
diff --git a/contrib/init/bitcoind.openrc b/contrib/init/bitcoind.openrc
index ae9dbf46e6..503cc9ba43 100644
--- a/contrib/init/bitcoind.openrc
+++ b/contrib/init/bitcoind.openrc
@@ -8,62 +8,41 @@ else
 	BITCOIND_DEFAULT_DATADIR="/var/lib/bitcoind"
 fi
 
+export SSD_NICELEVEL="${BITCOIND_NICE:-0}"
+
 BITCOIND_CONFIGFILE=${BITCOIND_CONFIGFILE:-/etc/bitcoin/bitcoin.conf}
-BITCOIND_PIDDIR=${BITCOIND_PIDDIR:-/var/run/bitcoind}
-BITCOIND_PIDFILE=${BITCOIND_PIDFILE:-${BITCOIND_PIDDIR}/bitcoind.pid}
+BITCOIND_PIDDIR=${BITCOIND_PIDDIR:-/run/bitcoind}
 BITCOIND_DATADIR=${BITCOIND_DATADIR:-${BITCOIND_DEFAULT_DATADIR}}
-BITCOIND_USER=${BITCOIND_USER:-${BITCOIN_USER:-bitcoin}}
-BITCOIND_GROUP=${BITCOIND_GROUP:-bitcoin}
-BITCOIND_BIN=${BITCOIND_BIN:-/usr/bin/bitcoind}
-BITCOIND_NICE=${BITCOIND_NICE:-${NICELEVEL:-0}}
-BITCOIND_OPTS="${BITCOIND_OPTS:-${BITCOIN_OPTS}}"
 
 name="Bitcoin Core Daemon"
 description="Bitcoin cryptocurrency P2P network daemon"
+pidfile=${BITCOIND_PIDFILE:-${BITCOIND_PIDDIR}/${RC_SVCNAME}.pid}
 
-command="${BITCOIND_BIN}"
-command_args="-pid=\"${BITCOIND_PIDFILE}\" \
+command=/usr/bin/bitcoind
+command_args="-pid=${pidfile} \
 		-conf=\"${BITCOIND_CONFIGFILE}\" \
 		-datadir=\"${BITCOIND_DATADIR}\" \
 		-daemon \
-		${BITCOIND_OPTS}"
+		${BITCOIND_OPTS:-${BITCOIN_OPTS}}"
+command_user="${BITCOIND_USER:-bitcoin}:${BITCOIND_GROUP:-bitcoin}"
 
 required_files="${BITCOIND_CONFIGFILE}"
-start_stop_daemon_args="-u ${BITCOIND_USER} \
-			-g ${BITCOIND_GROUP} \
-			-N ${BITCOIND_NICE} -w 2000"
-pidfile="${BITCOIND_PIDFILE}"
+start_stop_daemon_args="--wait 2000"
 
-# The retry schedule to use when stopping the daemon. Could be either
-# a timeout in seconds or multiple signal/timeout pairs (like
-# "SIGKILL/180 SIGTERM/300")
-retry="${BITCOIND_SIGTERM_TIMEOUT}"
+: ${retry:-600}
 
 depend() {
-	need localmount net
+	need localmount
+	use net
 }
 
-# verify
-# 1) that the datadir exists and is writable (or create it)
-# 2) that a directory for the pid exists and is writable
-# 3) ownership and permissions on the config file
 start_pre() {
-	checkpath \
-	-d \
-	--mode 0750 \
-	--owner "${BITCOIND_USER}:${BITCOIND_GROUP}" \
-	"${BITCOIND_DATADIR}"
-
-	checkpath \
-	-d \
-	--mode 0755 \
-	--owner "${BITCOIND_USER}:${BITCOIND_GROUP}" \
-	"${BITCOIND_PIDDIR}"
-
-	checkpath -f \
-	-o "${BITCOIND_USER}:${BITCOIND_GROUP}" \
-	-m 0660 \
-	"${BITCOIND_CONFIGFILE}"
+	# 1) datadir exists and is writable
+	# 2) piddir exists and is writable
+	# 3) conffile ownership and permissions
+	checkpath -d -o ${command_user} -m 0750 "${BITCOIND_DATADIR}"
+	checkpath -d -o ${command_user} -m 0755 "${BITCOIND_PIDDIR}"
+	checkpath -f -o ${command_user} -m 0660 "${BITCOIND_CONFIGFILE}"
 
 	checkconfig || return 1
 }
@@ -72,23 +51,24 @@ checkconfig()
 {
 	if grep -qs '^rpcuser=' "${BITCOIND_CONFIGFILE}" && \
 		! grep -qs '^rpcpassword=' "${BITCOIND_CONFIGFILE}" ; then
-		eerror ""
+		eerror
 		eerror "ERROR: You must set a secure rpcpassword to run bitcoind."
 		eerror "The setting must appear in ${BITCOIND_CONFIGFILE}"
-		eerror ""
+		eerror
 		eerror "This password is security critical to securing wallets "
 		eerror "and must not be the same as the rpcuser setting."
 		eerror "You can generate a suitable random password using the following "
 		eerror "command from the shell:"
-		eerror ""
+		eerror
 		eerror "bash -c 'tr -dc a-zA-Z0-9 < /dev/urandom | head -c32 && echo'"
-		eerror ""
+		eerror
 		eerror "It is recommended that you also set alertnotify so you are "
 		eerror "notified of problems:"
-		eerror ""
+		eerror
 		eerror "ie: alertnotify=echo %%s | mail -s \"Bitcoin Alert\"" \
 			"admin@foo.com"
-		eerror ""
+		eerror
 		return 1
 	fi
 }
+

</patch>

<previous_description>
{
 "summary": "Modernizes and simplifies the OpenRC init scripts located in contrib/init/openrc. It adopts modern OpenRC conventions such as using /run/ over /var/run/, removing the strict need net dependency, and utilizing standard variables like command_user, SSD_NICELEVEL, and retry. It also removes redundant configuration variables such as BITCOIND_BIN, BITCOIND_PIDFILE, and BITCOIND_SIGTERM_TIMEOUT.",
 "problem": "The OpenRC service scripts in contrib/init use dated idioms and configuration variables that are redundant or cause suboptimal behavior, such as restarting bitcoind whenever the system network service is restarted.",
 "card": "This PR updates and streamlines the OpenRC init scripts in contrib/init. It aligns the service script with current OpenRC best practices by switching to /run/, dropping redundant configuration options, and removing a hard dependency on the network service that needlessly forced bitcoind to restart during network restarts. The changes originate from an upstream Gentoo bug report (Gentoo bug #987059) and affect only users of OpenRC init systems running Bitcoin Core via contrib init scripts.",

 }
